digest.component_or_area: tickets store fetch and rebar initialization
propositions: Full clone of tickets costs 1.04 GiB / 59s; partial clone with blob:none costs 68.7 MiB / 14.3s — a ~15x reduction that CI should adopt via actions/checkout filter input.

When tickets fetch times out in Claude Code's web environment, rebar silently bootstraps a fresh empty store via worktree add --orphan, diverging from origin/tickets and returning empty results — this fail-open behavior must fail closed with non-zero exit.

Blob:none partial clone is safe for rebar's verify-identity operation because tree-level diffing and event/keyring body reads come from the working tree, not lazy blobs, though git blame on historical trees incurs materialization cost.
Reconcile-bridge workflow must set merge.ours.driver=true before blob:none filter is applied, otherwise merge-base blobs are removed and .bridge_state JSON merge degrades to silent 3-way text merge.
derive_caused_by must return None when per-path blame fails on any path, preventing partial culprit election that would differ from full-set analysis and write incorrect caused_by links.

Gerrit verify-identity job in gerrit-verify.yaml performs a full-history fetch identical to reconcile-bridge.yml and should also adopt blob:none filter to reduce 92% job overhead (6.73m measured cost).
